text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the north side of Clifton Avenue, between Wilmington Avenue and Honiton Street. The proposed parking amendment will deter day time parking at this location and will improve vehicular movements by maintaining clear passage for vehicles.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Clifton Avenue, between Wilmington Avenue and Honiton Street.
